purpose: Calibrated same-state recall demo, not a held-out generalization result.

corpus.selection_rule: Entire v2 predeclared trial sequence, stopped at first environment success; both completed trials included.

validation: A successful direct instruction probe is not an agent-system result. Record a separate three-agent episode, actual retrieved sources, actual executed instruction and environment predicate.
comparison_limit: Baseline and recalled episode share the same initialization used during instruction calibration; this demonstrates recall of a known local solution, not general improvement.
